verdict.rationale: Sprinto ships AI features, including an AI Editor for ingestion workflows and AI evidence validation, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can act as an MCP client. Nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to external MCP servers or use their tools. Its compliance-skills GitHub repo provides skills for other agents, and its integrations and inbound webhooks are fixed connectors, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
